rule: GOAL: Arrange colored blocks in the top row to match the required sequence. CONTROLS: Click a block in the bottom palette to select it, then click an empty slot above to place it. RULE: Each placement consumes one step from the limited timer; plan the order carefully. TRAP: Assuming you can drag blocks directly; you must perform two distinct clicks for every placement.

GOAL: Move the player to the target using a limited number of steps. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide the player until hitting a wall or obstacle. RULE: Movement is continuous sliding; you cannot stop in empty space. TRAP: Pressing a direction key repeatedly does not allow mid-slide stopping.

GOAL: Drop the block into the castle notch. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the paddle; spacebar drops the block. RULE: The block slides to the nearest paddle end before falling, so centering the paddle ensures a clean drop. TRAP: Assuming the block falls straight down from its landing spot ignores the sliding mechanic.

GOAL: Slide the blue key horizontally to align with the gap in the black barrier. CONTROLS: Click the left blue arrow to shift the key left; click the right blue arrow to shift it right. RULE: The key only moves when you click the specific blue arrow buttons, not the background or the key itself. TRAP: Clicking empty white space or the gray panels does nothing; you must target the small blue arrows precisely.

GOAL: Move the purple marker to the start by jumping over dots. CONTROLS: Click a slot to jump there; dots between you and the target shift one step forward. RULE: You can only jump if every slot between your current spot and the target is occupied. TRAP: Assuming empty gaps help; they actually block jumps because the shifting dots have nowhere to go.

GOAL: Match the five pink slot glyphs to the corresponding sky letters by adjusting each column independently. CONTROLS: Left and right arrows move the cursor between columns; up and down arrows cycle the glyph in the current column. RULE: The level clears immediately when every pink glyph matches its sky counterpart, requiring no extra confirmation step. TRAP: Assuming you must align columns in left-to-right order wastes moves; you can fix any slot in any sequence.

GOAL: Guide the key into the exit gap by managing the shifting corridor. CONTROLS: Click below the bar to widen the passage; click the key to move it right. RULE: The key only advances when the top barrier has moved left enough to create space. TRAP: Clicking the key alone fails if the corridor is too narrow; always expand the space before moving.

GOAL: Reorder five colored blocks on two tracks to match a hidden sequence, then confirm with space. CONTROLS: Click a block to lift it, click a slot to place it, and press space to test the arrangement. RULE: Only the first mismatched position flashes, revealing the correct color for that specific slot. TRAP: Believing the entire sequence must be perfect to gain any feedback wastes time; use partial successes to deduce colors.

GOAL: Set seven rotating symbols to match the static row above. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor and rotate the selected symbol. RULE: Match the symbol shape, ignoring its current rotation angle. TRAP: Trying to match exact visual orientation wastes turns; only the identity matters.

GOAL: Place seven letter tiles into three separate boxes to match the target sequence. CONTROLS: Click a tile from the palette, then click an empty slot in a box. Press space to submit. RULE: Reading order follows the red box, but jumps to a linked green or blue box when hitting a socket. TRAP: Assuming strict left-to-right across all boxes ignores the socket jumps, causing mismatched letter positions.

GOAL: Place three boxes into their matching target spots using a single carry slot. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player and shift carried boxes; Space picks up or drops the current box. RULE: You can only carry one box at a time, requiring careful routing to avoid blocking your path. TRAP: Trying to pick up a second box before dropping the first fails silently, wasting turns.

GOAL: Fill every section of the T shapes to make them solid. CONTROLS: Clicking a horizontal bar toggles it; clicking a vertical stem toggles that stem. RULE: The yellow plug icon shows the target state: a completely solid, filled block. TRAP: Assuming the yellow shapes hint at a split pattern where tops are dark and bottoms are light.

GOAL: Arrange colored pieces in nested boxes to form the target sequence Y, R, N, b, M, O, p. CONTROLS: Click palette items to select, then click empty slots to place them; press Space to submit the solution. RULE: A special ring piece acts as a hole, causing the inner green box sequence to splice into the outer red box reading order at that spot. TRAP: Assuming slots read strictly left-to-right across all boxes ignores the nested expansion rule caused by the ring piece.

GOAL: Move the player to the green target cell. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one step in that direction. RULE: Red enemies charge only along their facing line, ignoring perpendicular approaches. TRAP: Assuming red blocks kill on any contact; attacking from the side or back is safe.

GOAL: Arrange solids so the target sequence contains two identical three-item blocks. CONTROLS: Click palette items to fill red slots and the blue box. Press space to check. RULE: The blue box content must appear twice in the final sequence, at the red socket positions. TRAP: Assuming sockets are non-adjacent wastes time; they can be consecutive, creating overlapping or adjacent repeating blocks.

GOAL: Arrange colored boxes in order to match the target sequence. CONTROLS: Click palette items to fill slots; press space to submit. RULE: Each box's first item must match its color, forcing a specific order. TRAP: Assuming left-to-right box placement; the correct order was blue, then orange, then green.

GOAL: Decode glyph pairs to form a target sky row, then rotate slots to match the sequence. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor and rotate the selected slot through its glyph cycle. RULE: Yellow and sky tiles form unique phrase pairs; their lengths must sum to seven for the final row. TRAP: Assuming single glyphs per pair ignores multi-glyph patterns, breaking the segmentation logic.

GOAL: Raise liquid surfaces to match green marker heights by moving volume between adjacent pools. CONTROLS: Click left button to raise left pool and lower right; click right button to raise right pool and lower left. RULE: Actions are blocked if the source pool is too low to give or the destination is too high to accept. TRAP: Assuming any button press works regardless of fluid levels; invalid moves waste actions without changing state.

GOAL: Place colored rings inside boxes to expand their capacity and match the seven-slot target sequence. CONTROLS: Click palette items to select, click box slots to place, and press Space to verify the solution. RULE: Rings placed in boxes act as portals, inserting the connected box’s contents into the main sequence. TRAP: Assuming rings only sit in the top box; nesting them in lower boxes is required to reach the length.

ESTABLISHED: Clicking white cells turns them green. Filling four triggers a transfer event where cells turn purple, fade, and the plug recharges. The small panel shows four static purple dots. FAILED: Filling all white cells with mouse-clicked green does not clear the level. The small panel never changes state. GOAL IS NOT: Simply painting all white cells green with the mouse. CONTROLS: Mouse clicks paint cells green. Right arrow flashes light. Plug tip length remains constant during clicks.

GOAL: Move two separate blocks to touch and merge into one. CONTROLS: Click near a block to slide it toward your cursor; click between two close blocks to combine them. RULE: A block only moves if the click is within its reach limit, sliding it directly to that spot. TRAP: Assuming you can merge blocks from any distance; they must be close enough for a single click to affect both.

GOAL: Guide the player to the exit at the grid's edge without getting caught. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide the player until hitting a wall, obstacle, or enemy. RULE: Enemies scan straight lines; you are safe if a red enemy blocks another's view. TRAP: Assuming you must dodge every visible enemy; sometimes hiding behind one is the only safe path.

GOAL: Match the socket’s notch orientation, then replicate the left panel’s light pattern on the right machine. CONTROLS: Click boxes to select plug orientation; click right-machine cells to toggle lights; click the ball to finish. RULE: The selected box’s plug must fit the socket’s bump, and its left-panel display reveals the exact code to enter. TRAP: Assuming the code is static; it changes based on which box is selected, so verify the display after switching.

ESTABLISHED: Pulling compresses the wire chain, dragging blocks together and pushing them as a unit. FAILED: Trying to park blocks sequentially without first separating the outer blocks from the inner ones. GOAL IS NOT: Simply dragging the entire chain to the base; the blocks must arrive at specific, spaced intervals. CONTROLS: Pulling moves the tip block left; if blocked, it pushes the next block, compressing the gap between them.

GOAL: Rotate seven glyph slots to match a fixed dictionary order. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor; Up rotates the selected slot forward through its cycle. RULE: Each slot cycles through a unique, repeating sequence of seven distinct states. TRAP: Assuming slots share a rotation cycle or order wastes time on failed synchronization attempts.

GOAL: Match the panel's color pattern to the reference plug tip using arrow keys to move the cursor. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the painting cursor; clicking changes cell colors. RULE: The plug tip only accepts the pattern when facing left, requiring specific cursor positioning before finalizing. TRAP: Believing any orientation works; wasting actions on right-facing checks instead of immediately rotating left.

GOAL: Guide two colored bars to the central target using directional glyphs. CONTROLS: Clicking a glyph extends or retracts the adjacent bar in the direction its opening faces. RULE: The glyph’s opening points toward the bar’s growing tip, indicating the direction of movement. TRAP: Assuming bars stop at the target; they actually extend one unit past the center, requiring precise length control.

GOAL: Place each colored cross so its arms cover all matching dots. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected cross; Space switches between crosses. RULE: Each cross covers four dots in a plus shape; both must be aligned simultaneously. TRAP: Assuming crosses can overlap or that moving one affects the other; they act independently.

GOAL: Rotate the outer ring of blocks until the yellow block sits inside the bracket at the top-left corner. CONTROLS: Click the red arrow to rotate the ring counter-clockwise. Click the green arrow to rotate it clockwise. RULE: The ring rotates as a single unit; blocks move to adjacent positions, carrying the yellow block toward the target. TRAP: Clicking the yellow block itself does nothing; it cannot be moved independently of the ring rotation.

GOAL: Move the orange X to the blue target by navigating past static blue obstacles. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected piece; SPACE switches between orange and blue pieces. RULE: Pieces can pass through each other and obstacles without blocking movement. TRAP: Assuming overlapping paths were blocked wasted time; movement was always possible.

GOAL: Clear the red guard and slide to the exit. CONTROLS: Arrows slide you until you hit a wall or object. RULE: Colliding with the red guard destroys it, removing its deadly threat. TRAP: Believing the guard’s target square remains fatal even after the guard is destroyed.

GOAL: Place the white block into the diamond-shaped socket. CONTROLS: Clicking a block moves the entire chain along its fixed diagonal axis. RULE: The chain slides rigidly; individual blocks cannot separate or rotate independently. TRAP: Believing the ring must be reached by moving the chain to it; instead, click the ring to snap the white block directly into the socket.

GOAL: Match the miniature pattern shown inside the target grid’s center. CONTROLS: Click main grid cells to toggle their color state. RULE: White in the mini pattern means red; gray means blue. TRAP: Assuming the mini pattern is just a mirror of the current state.

GOAL: Move three shapes to cover all scattered dots. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected shape; Space cycles selection. RULE: Every dot must be covered by a shape’s area. TRAP: Assuming shapes block each other; they overlap freely.

GOAL: Place the two yellow blocks into the designated target slots at the bottom. CONTROLS: Click red arrows to shift rings or rows forward; click green arrows to shift them backward. RULE: Red ring shifts content one step forward, while green ring reverses that exact movement. TRAP: Assuming rows and rings move identically; they operate on different axes, so mixing them up creates chaos.

GOAL: Change specific blue cells to orange to match the hidden white stencil pattern. CONTROLS: Click a grid cell to toggle its color from blue to orange. RULE: Only cells marked white in the stencil overlay should become orange; gray marks stay blue. TRAP: Believing the top-right color blocks were a clickable menu or score counter, wasting time looking for hidden buttons.

GOAL: Align the block with the top panel and insert it. CONTROLS: Arrows move the block; landings rotate the legend. RULE: The legend must match the panel before insertion succeeds. TRAP: Assuming any legend alignment works; you must land to rotate it first.

GOAL: Reduce the board to a single peg by jumping over neighbors. CONTROLS: Click a peg to select it, then click the empty landing spot to jump. RULE: Jumps are only legal if an adjacent peg exists and the landing cell is empty. TRAP: Clicking a landing spot without first selecting a peg does nothing, wasting a move.

GOAL: Turn every red cell orange to match the target pattern. CONTROLS: Clicking a red cell turns it orange. RULE: Only click cells that need to be orange; leave red cells alone. TRAP: Believing you must click every cell or that stencils need changing wastes time and fails the level.

GOAL: Place the token into the ring’s hole. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the token three cells per press; clicks nudged a sliding block. RULE: The token moves a fixed three-cell step, landing exactly inside the hole. TRAP: Assuming the ring blocked the token like a wall wasted time.

GOAL: Move the yellow and orange markers to their matching colored slots on opposite rings. CONTROLS: Left arrows spin the left ring; right arrows spin the right ring. RULE: The rings share two slots, allowing markers to transfer between circles when aligned. TRAP: Assuming rings are isolated; ignoring shared slots prevents solving the puzzle.

GOAL: Move both blocks into the opposite chambers to complete the swap. CONTROLS: Arrows move all blocks simultaneously in the pressed direction. RULE: Blocks can pass through each other when moving inward along the spiral. TRAP: Assuming blocks block each other prevents the necessary overlap to switch sides.

GOAL: Paint all color blocks by dragging shape arms through their swatches. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active shape; Space switches between shapes. RULE: A shape only changes color when its arm physically touches the matching swatch. TRAP: Assuming the center must overlap the swatch; actually, only the extended arm needs to reach it.

GOAL: Match the color of the five white squares to the center square’s color. CONTROLS: Click a square to cycle its color blue, red, then orange. RULE: White squares must copy the center’s final color, not stay white. TRAP: Assuming white squares should remain white or turn red wastes clicks; they must become orange here.

GOAL: Move the yellow and orange blocks to specific target squares. CONTROLS: Click arrows to rotate the entire horizontal or vertical ring of blocks. RULE: The board forms two intersecting loops sharing four center slots; rotating one shifts contents along that path. TRAP: Treating the board as independent rows or columns fails because shared slots change simultaneously during any rotation.

GOAL: Reach the exit panel by matching the legend's rotation through specific grid entries. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the block; entering cells consumes energy but records rotation steps. RULE: Ring cells act as emergency fuel refills, extending your action budget when energy runs low. TRAP: Assuming rings are static obstacles wastes time; treat them as critical, reusable energy sources.

ESTABLISHED: A red snake occupies the top-right and extends to the bottom-left. A blue square interacts with the snake's head. FAILED: Moving the blue square left or down after the head retracts does not clear the level or change the red path. GOAL IS NOT: Simply eating the red head, as the snake instantly regrows to its original full length once the blue square moves away. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the blue square; Space activates an unknown action.

GOAL: Move both yellow blocks into the top row’s outer slots. CONTROLS: Top arrows spin the top row; side arrows cycle the vertical loop. RULE: Side loops feed the top row only at specific connection points. TRAP: Thinking any side rotation places blocks in the top row; you must align the loop’s exit with the row’s entry first.

GOAL: Move two blocks into adjacent horizontal alignment without hitting hazards. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move both blocks simultaneously in the chosen direction. RULE: Movement fails entirely if either block would enter a hazard cell. TRAP: Assuming one block can move while the other is blocked by a hazard.

GOAL: Rotate the plug to face the socket, then move it into place to connect. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the plug; SPACE rotates it ninety degrees. RULE: Rotation pivots on the top-left corner, so you must move after turning to align. TRAP: Thinking rotation happens in the center causes misalignment and wasted moves.

GOAL: Swap the two L-shapes between the left and right chambers across the divider. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move both shapes simultaneously in mirrored directions; right pushes them toward the center. RULE: Shapes pass through each other and the divider, allowing a direct swap by moving toward the middle. TRAP: Assuming the yellow shape was interactive or that shapes blocked one another wasted time testing overlaps.

GOAL: Match the board to the static gray patterns. CONTROLS: Click buttons to toggle neighbors; click plain cells to toggle themselves. RULE: Gray minis define required colors: W means same as center, g means opposite. TRAP: Believing gray stencils update dynamically; they are fixed targets, so plan all clicks before acting.

GOAL: Guide the green knob to the yellow target marker. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the knob; clicks toggled panel states to open or close paths. RULE: Toggling panels changed which grid cells were walkable, creating a maze for the knob to traverse. TRAP: Assuming panels were just decorative goals wasted time; they were actually switches controlling the knob's movement path.

GOAL: Reach the exit by using a replayed ghost to trigger a switch that opens a gate. CONTROLS: Arrows move the character; the spacebar records a path or plays back a ghost. RULE: The ghost follows the exact path recorded earlier, activating switches when it passes over them. TRAP: Assuming the ghost vanishes after moving; it actually persists to hold the gate open for your real character.

GOAL: Fill the yellow target shape using the dotted black stencil. CONTROLS: Arrows slide the shapes horizontally; SPACE swaps white dots between the divider and the shape’s holes. RULE: Only the shape holding the white dots can move vertically to align with the target. TRAP: Assuming vertical movement always works wastes turns; you must swap dots to the shape first to enable vertical navigation.

GOAL: Reach the exit without colliding with moving hazards. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide the character until a wall or hazard stops them. RULE: Hazards move after every player action, creating a turn-based rhythm. TRAP: Assuming you can stop mid-slide or that hazards move before you.

GOAL: Guide the green avatar to the bottom icon to trigger the next phase. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the avatar vertically and horizontally across the grid. RULE: Touching the icon consumes it and unlocks a new colored panel on the right. TRAP: The red section of the icon looks like a hazard, but it is safe to cross.

GOAL: Fill the target block with white on top and purple on bottom. CONTROLS: Space pushes ink into a band; arrows rotate your view; mouse selects ink color. RULE: Pushes dye the row band you are currently facing. TRAP: Believing one push fills the whole block; it only dyes the specific band facing you.

GOAL: Align alternating pink and sky tiles to specific targets. CONTROLS: Arrows move cursor; presses cycle tile values. RULE: Pink and sky tiles follow separate, fixed cycles. TRAP: Assuming one shared cycle wastes moves; probe each color separately.

ESTABLISHED: The player remains fixed in screen rows while the maze scrolls down past them. The player is trapped in the first band after the initial scroll event. Water rising from below kills the player on contact. FAILED: Climbing the maze structure repeatedly did not change the player's screen position or escape the band. Moving left into the black notch did not allow descent. GOAL IS NOT: Simply climbing the visible maze structure to reach a top exit. CONTROLS: Left moves the player horizontally. Action 6 triggers the maze scroll. Water rises automatically.

GOAL: Shrink the tip to fit the narrow valve and reach the head. CONTROLS: Arrows move the block; clicking panel cells paints them. RULE: Matching the panel pattern shrinks the block from four units to two. TRAP: Thinking the channel is four wide; charcoal grips narrow it to two.

GOAL: Guide the square to the exit using limited moves. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the square; Space confirms the path. RULE: The square only moves in straight lines until it hits a wall. TRAP: Believing you can stop mid-slide; you cannot, so plan routes around obstacles.

GOAL: Paint the upper triangle purple and lower region white, then finish with orange. CONTROLS: Arrow keys rotate the bracket; mouse selects ink color; space pushes dye. RULE: Dye fills cells swept by the bracket’s opening as it rotates. TRAP: Assuming a 225-degree push dyes the opposite side; it actually colors the lower-right diagonal.

GOAL: Reach the exit while avoiding patrolling hazards. CONTROLS: Arrows move you one space per turn. RULE: Enemies occupy specific cells at specific times, requiring precise timing to pass. TRAP: Assuming enemies are static or blocking only when visible, ignoring hidden threats or delayed arrivals.

GOAL: Align yellow tokens with bracket targets. CONTROLS: Green and red arrows rotate vertical or horizontal groups; specific buttons shift rows or rotate corners. RULE: Arrows cycle contents in fixed loops; matching a token’s path to a target ensures alignment. TRAP: Assuming adjacent swaps instead of full cycles causes misalignment, as the third token in a loop often moves invisibly.

GOAL: Guide the block to the yellow square by opening paths. CONTROLS: Arrows move the block; clicks rotate red bars or pour purple liquid. RULE: Purple liquid instantly solidifies all hatch slots, creating a solid bridge. TRAP: Assuming liquid only fills one slot; it fills all, making the route continuous.

GOAL: Move the yellow piece to the target circle in five steps. CONTROLS: Click near the piece to slide it one cell toward the cursor. RULE: Clicks outside the reach radius are ignored, so stay close to move efficiently. TRAP: Mistaking the header indicator for the game piece wastes actions on no-ops.

GOAL: Park three blocks at their target spots to open the gate. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active block; clicks switch which block is active. RULE: Only the clicked block moves; inactive blocks freeze in place. TRAP: Assuming all blocks move together; they do not, requiring careful switching.

GOAL: Move three shapes to cover matching colored dots without touching any blocks. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected shape; Spacebar switches to the next shape. RULE: A shape only works if its color matches the dots it covers after touching a matching paint block. TRAP: Assuming you can paint a shape without moving it into the block causes wasted turns; you must physically enter the block.

GOAL: Move the plug through a gap to reach the socket using minimal clicks. CONTROLS: Up and Right arrows shift the plug one cell per press. RULE: The plug stops immediately after moving, allowing precise alignment with the narrow gap. TRAP: Assuming the plug slides until hitting a wall causes overshooting; it only moves one step per click.

GOAL: Rotate the bracket to specific angles around the target, then stamp colors in sequence. CONTROLS: Arrows rotate the bracket clockwise or counter-clockwise; clicks select ink and confirm placement. RULE: Movement follows a fixed circular path; each arrow press advances one step along that ring. TRAP: Assuming arrow directions correspond to screen coordinates rather than rotational steps causes blocked moves and wasted actions.

GOAL: Merge two blocks and deliver the result to the target zone. CONTROLS: Click a location to move the nearest block or merge blocks if close enough. RULE: Merging requires clicking a point within range of both blocks simultaneously. TRAP: Ignoring the chasing diamond’s position; merging too early allowed it to consume the combined block before delivery.

GOAL: Move the two large mirrored blocks to collide by first clearing the path with the small block. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active group; clicks switch between the small block and the paired large blocks. RULE: The right large block mirrors the left one’s movement, but the small block moves independently. TRAP: Assuming all blocks move simultaneously or identically causes collisions and wasted turns.

GOAL: Align the active shape's holes with the divider's gaps to clear the path. CONTROLS: Arrows move the currently highlighted object; Space cycles which object is active. RULE: Only the object marked with white dots responds to arrow inputs. TRAP: Pressing Space repeatedly without checking the highlight causes wasted moves on inactive objects.

GOAL: Move the block to the target zone and face right to open the gate. CONTROLS: Arrows shift the block; direction determines which half is dark. RULE: The dark half always trails behind the movement, so the final move must be right to face right. TRAP: Pressing right repeatedly does not rotate the block; it only shifts it until blocked, leaving the orientation unchanged.

GOAL: Move three items to targets while keeping two zones valid. CONTROLS: Click to swap items between zones or move one to a target. RULE: Chains connecting items must stay clear of the center obstacle. TRAP: Assuming a swap is always safe; placing items too close to the center breaks the chain rule and fails the level.

GOAL: Rotate the bracket to four cardinal positions to push dye bands and stamp a small block. CONTROLS: Arrow keys rotate the bracket clockwise or counter-clockwise by 45 degrees. Mouse selects ink colors. Space pushes dye from the bracket’s current angle. RULE: Moves mirror each other; Left from 225° lands on 180°, just as Right from 180° lands on 225°. TRAP: Assuming diagonal positions allow direct pushes to cardinal targets wastes turns; you must rotate through intermediate angles.

GOAL: Align the blue half to face left at the shaft mouth, then trigger the transfer to open the gate and navigate to the head. CONTROLS: Arrows move the piece; clicks activate mechanisms; direction determines ink flow. RULE: Ink flows only from the blue half’s facing side; position must be adjacent, not inside the shaft. TRAP: Entering the shaft blocks flow or causes over-insertion; stay at the chamber edge with the blue half facing left.

GOAL: Shrink the block into a plug and drop it into the wall gap. CONTROLS: Left arrow moves the block; the middle control transforms the shape; Down arrows lower it. RULE: The transformed piece anchors to the top-left of the original block. TRAP: Thinking the piece centers itself, causing it to miss the narrow socket.

GOAL: Fill a triangle with specific colors by stacking semi-transparent dyes in a precise order. CONTROLS: Arrows rotate your view; clicks select ink colors; space pushes dye into the grid. RULE: Later colors overwrite earlier ones, so push broad shapes first and let smaller shapes cover the overlaps. TRAP: Assuming the diagonal belongs to the first color; it actually gets overwritten by the second, so order matters.

GOAL: Fit three numbered tokens into their matching ring-shaped holes by sliding them across the grid. CONTROLS: Click a token to select it, then use arrow keys to slide it one step in that direction. RULE: Tokens slide freely until hitting a wall or another token, but must stop exactly when filling a ring's center. TRAP: Assuming you can stop a slide mid-path; you cannot, so plan exact distances to avoid overshooting the target.

GOAL: Move the four green blocks to the target ring by swapping them with the worker. CONTROLS: Click a block to swap it with the worker; click an empty space to move the worker. RULE: The sum of the four block coordinates must equal the target ring's total coordinate value. TRAP: Thinking you must move blocks one by one to their final spots; you must swap blocks out to temporary holding spots to adjust the total sum gradually.

GOAL: Crash two blocks by opening purple doors. CONTROLS: Arrows moved both blocks simultaneously in the same direction. RULE: Doors opened only while a block stood on a pressure plate. TRAP: Moving the block off the plate to pass through closed the door instantly.

GOAL: Place real and reflected shapes to cover two target zones completely. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active shape; Space switches which shape is active. RULE: Reflections appear mirrored across the horizontal midline of the screen. TRAP: Assuming reflections stay static; they move in sync with their real counterparts.

ESTABLISHED: The paddle starts at rows 36-39, cols 20-39. Red bars occupy rows 16-19 and 24-27. A blue paddle is at rows 32-35, cols 12-31. FAILED: Moving the block to exit left from the red bar caused death, suggesting the first contact must be with the blue paddle, not the red bar. GOAL IS NOT: Simply pushing the block off the red bar to the left without interacting with the blue paddle first. CONTROLS: Left/Right moves the block. Clicking places it. Space launches.

GOAL: Ride a moving strip to cross a gap, then walk to the exit. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player; yellow clicks advance the strip; gray clicks reset the floor. RULE: The strip only carries you if you stand on its rightmost edge before it advances. TRAP: Believing any position on the strip works; standing in the middle leaves you stranded when it moves.

GOAL: Place the shape over the yellow target area. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the active object; Space cycles selection between dividers and the shape. RULE: Only the highlighted object responds to movement; dots indicate which piece is currently active. TRAP: Assuming all pieces move simultaneously wastes time; you must cycle through objects to find the right one.

GOAL: Push the diamond into the designated circle using only three precise moves. CONTROLS: Clicking a spot applies force, kicking the diamond away from the cursor across the board. RULE: The diamond travels twice the distance from its center to your click, landing at the mirrored point. TRAP: Assuming you can drag the piece; clicking too close traps it, while distant clicks overshoot the target.

GOAL: Move both bars to cover the target squares without overlapping the central block. CONTROLS: Arrows shifted the horizontal and vertical bars simultaneously in that direction. RULE: If a bar hit a wall or the block, it stayed put while the other bar continued moving. TRAP: Assuming both bars always move together, causing you to miss the window where one is blocked.

GOAL: Group items into two separate clusters that stay apart while moving to their targets. CONTROLS: Click empty space to move, click an item to swap it with your position. RULE: Items in the same group must remain close, but different groups must keep distance. TRAP: Assuming you could move an item without swapping into its spot, causing unintended chain breaks.

GOAL: Slide the long piece left to snap into the distant socket. CONTROLS: Arrows move your character; pushing the piece moves it. RULE: When overlapping obstacles, the piece creeps one cell per push instead of sliding fully. TRAP: Assuming pushes block when overlapping; they actually allow incremental movement through tight spaces.

GOAL: Guide the ghost to the socket while keeping the blue ping-pong active. CONTROLS: Arrows move the ghost; wait by toggling left/right to burn time. RULE: The ghost must wait until the blue completes its cycle before entering. TRAP: Rushing the ghost causes it to miss the timing window and fail.

ESTABLISHED: You are at rows 32-35, cols 12-19, facing right. The O has moved left six times, placing its box at cols 12-15, rows 40-43. FAILED: Moving down immediately risks collision if the O moves up into your path. GOAL IS NOT: A simple drop; the O's movement logic is unpredictable. CONTROLS: Left moves the head. Down shifts the body. The O moves once per player action.

GOAL: Collect two rings to refill a draining resource meter, then navigate to the final panel before the meter empties. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the character; moving onto a ring refills the meter, and moving onto the panel completes the level. RULE: The meter drains by two units per move; you must return to a ring before it hits zero to continue safely. TRAP: Assuming you can reach the end without a second refill wastes time; you must loop back to the second ring after the first collection.

ESTABLISHED: The level requires aligning three distinct key heads within specific vertical wall segments. FAILED: Simply placing heads inside wall bounds or moving them to arbitrary positions without precise vertical alignment. GOAL IS NOT: A simple match of head coordinates or equalizing water levels across pools. CONTROLS: Vertical movement adjusts head position; horizontal movement shifts alignment relative to wall gaps.

ESTABLISHED: Two sockets share a contact cell. FAILED: Checking for distinct contacts or ignoring overlaps. GOAL IS NOT: A simple two-point bridge with separate contacts. CONTROLS: Identify shared cells; require distinct contact points from different sockets for valid connections.
